chats.answer:
If you're looking for an enclosed 3D printer that supports multiple filament colors or materials, I'd focus on printers with automatic filament switching (AMS or similar systems).

There are two important distinctions:

Multi-color printing: Automatically switches between filaments to print different colors in one job.

Multi-material printing: Uses different materials, such as PLA, PETG, and support filament. Not every multi-color system supports every material combination.
